latestVersion.changelog:
- Major update: Skill repurposed from "ontology" (typed knowledge graph) to "self-improvement" (logging learnings and errors for continuous improvement).
- Replaced all ontology and schema functionality with capturing learnings, errors, and feature requests in markdown files under `.learnings/`.
- Added new asset/reference files: LEARNINGS.md, ERRORS.md, FEATURE_REQUESTS.md, skill template, OpenClaw integration docs, and setup scripts.
- Removed legacy ontology references, schemas, and Python scripts.
- Added OpenClaw-specific setup instructions and hook workflow for automatic reminders.
- Provided structured logging formats and guidelines for promoting learnings to AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, and CLAUDE.md.
